name: agent-skills
description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
one_liner: A packaged set of senior-engineer habits (write a spec first, test before shipping, review code health before merging) that you install into an AI coding tool so it follows a disciplined process instead of writing whatever it feels like.
buyer: An engineering manager who lets junior developers or non-engineers use AI coding tools and needs guardrails so the output is actually production-safe.
business_use_cases: A startup with mostly junior engineers installs it to enforce spec-first, test-driven development across every AI-assisted change.
A no-code-to-code agency uses the review and ship commands to bring non-engineer-built AI apps up to a shippable quality bar.
A consultancy sells 'AI engineering process setup' to clients who've adopted AI coding tools but have no quality process around them.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'AI engineering process audit and setup' consulting package for teams adopting AI coding tools at scale.
Run training workshops teaching teams the spec-plan-build-test-review-ship workflow built around this skill set.

steal_this: This is a free dev-process tool with no built-in monetization; the realistic weekend move is packaging a one-day 'AI engineering process' workshop for a local dev team, not building a product on top of it.
